definitions.DIRECT_ROOT: A CREDITED CONTEXT/FAMILY WHOSE FROZEN ACCEPTANCE IS PROVED BY AN INDEPENDENT FULL-SCOPE UNIVERSAL EXHAUSTIVE ABSOLUTE FIXED-BAR MATCHED OR THEORETICAL/OBJECTIVE-CEILING WITNESS WITHOUT INHERITING DOMINANCE FROM ANOTHER CREDITED CONTEXT.
definitions.TRANSPORT_EDGE: A LOAD-BEARING CONTEXT/COMPOSITION TRANSFORM USED AS A LOGICAL PREMISE TO INHERIT OR TRANSPORT A SOURCE DOMINANCE CERTIFICATE INTO A DIFFERENT TARGET CONTEXT.
definitions.LOCAL_C_CERTIFICATE: CONTENT-ADDRESSED TRANSFORM/LAW BOUNDARY PLUS COMPLETE LOAD-BEARING STATE QUOTIENT, TARGET-EVALUATOR PULLBACKS, HARD-CONSTRAINT PREIMAGES/INVARIANTS, AND INDEPENDENT OR OBJECTIVE VERIFICATION.
definitions.CREDITED_PROOF_GRAPH: DIRECT ROOTS PLUS ONLY THE TRANSPORT EDGES ACTUALLY USED BY CURRENT CREDITED PROOF PATHS.

theorem.statement: GLOBAL SOUNDNESS OF THE CURRENT CREDITED PROOF GRAPH REQUIRES C CERTIFICATES ONLY ON TRANSPORT EDGES ACTUALLY USED TO INHERIT DOMINANCE. DIRECT ROOTS REQUIRE NO C TRANSPORT EDGE. UNINSTANTIATED OR UNCREDITED FUTURE TRANSFORMS NEED NOT BE PREPROVED IF THE PROMOTION BOUNDARY FAILS CLOSED ON ANY FUTURE TRANSPORT EDGE LACKING A LOCAL C CERTIFICATE.
proof: DIRECT ROOTS ARE SOUND BY THEIR OWN INDEPENDENT FULL-SCOPE PROOF AND DO NOT USE TRANSFORM PRESERVATION AS A PREMISE.
FOR A TRANSPORTED NODE, ASSUME ITS PARENT DOMINANCE PROOF IS SOUND AND THE EDGE HAS A VALID LOCAL C CERTIFICATE. THE EXISTING PULLBACK/TRANSFORM THEOREMS IMPLY THE TARGET DOMINANCE CLAIM IS SOUND.
BY INDUCTION OVER AN ACYCLIC CREDITED PROOF DAG, EVERY CREDITED NODE IS SOUND WHEN EVERY NONROOT EDGE HAS ITS LOCAL C CERTIFICATE.
A TRANSFORM NOT PRESENT ON ANY CURRENT CREDITED PROOF PATH IS NOT A PREMISE OF CURRENT CREDITED TRUTH. PREPROVING IT CANNOT BE LOGICALLY NECESSARY TO CURRENT PROOF SOUNDNESS.
IF THE PROMOTION GATE REJECTS EVERY NEW TRANSPORTED CREDIT UNTIL ITS EDGE CERTIFICATE PASSES, THE INVARIANT IS PRESERVED UNDER GRAPH GROWTH.

strict_C_first_countermodel.current_graph: FIVE CURRENT ACCEPTED FAMILIES ARE ALL DIRECT FULL-SCOPE PROOF ROOTS AND USE ZERO DOMINANCE-TRANSPORT EDGES.
facts: CURRENT CREDITED GRAPH IS SOUND WITHOUT PREPROVING ANY UNINSTANTIATED FUTURE CONTEXT TRANSFORM.
A+B CAN DISCOVER A NEW TARGET CONTEXT AND CANDIDATE ROUTE WITHOUT GRANTING IT CREDIT.
IF THAT ROUTE USES A TRANSPORT EDGE, PROMOTION REMAINS BLOCKED UNTIL THE LOCAL C CERTIFICATE PASSES.
THEREFORE GLOBAL C COMPLETION BEFORE A+B DISCOVERY IS NOT A NECESSARY SERIAL PRECONDITION.
strict_C_first_countermodel.conclusion: REPLACE STRICT C_FIRST SERIALIZATION WITH EDGE_LOCAL C_ON_DEMAND JOINED AT PROMOTION.

scheduler_repair: RUN A+B TARGET-ESCAPE/SEMANTIC DISCOVERY AND LOCAL C CERTIFICATION CONCURRENTLY.
DIRECT FULL-SCOPE PROOF ROUTE -> NO C TRANSPORT EDGE REQUIRED.
DERIVED/COMPOSED ROUTE -> CONSTRUCT ONLY ITS ACTUAL LOAD-BEARING TRANSFORM EDGE CERTIFICATE.
PROMOTION JOINS ONLY AFTER A+B SEMANTIC/DISTRIBUTIONAL PROOF + LOCAL C EDGE CERTIFICATES + RESOURCE/SAFETY/AUTHORITY + D OWNERSHIP BINDINGS.
DO NOT PREENUMERATE OR PRECERTIFY TRANSFORMS THAT ARE NOT USED BY A CANDIDATE CREDITED PROOF.
B9 REMAINS DERIVATIVE: ANY B9 ROUTE FAILURE LOCALIZES TO PRIMITIVE SEMANTICS OR A LOCAL C EDGE CERTIFICATE; NO INDEPENDENT B9 TARGET HUNT IS RESTORED.
falsifiers: A CURRENT CREDITED FAMILY ACTUALLY RELIES ON AN UNBOUND DOMINANCE-TRANSPORT EDGE.
A DIRECT-PROOF ROOT IS NOT SCOPE-COMPLETE OR INDEPENDENT UNDER ITS FROZEN ACCEPTANCE RULE.
THE PROMOTION PATH CAN CREDIT A TRANSPORTED ROUTE WITHOUT PASSING THE LOCAL C GATE.
A FUTURE TRANSFORM CAN CHANGE CURRENT CREDITED TRUTH BEFORE IT IS USED BY ANY CREDITED PROOF PATH.
THE CREDITED PROOF GRAPH CAN CONTAIN A CYCLE THAT INVALIDATES THE INDUCTIVE SOUNDNESS ARGUMENT.
hard_nonclaims: NO CLAIM ALL FUTURE C TRANSFORMS ARE CERTIFIED.
NO CLAIM C IS GLOBALLY CLOSED FOR EVERY FUTURE GENERATED ROUTE.
NO CLAIM THE CURRENT PROMOTION INTEGRATOR ALREADY CALLS THIS NEW C GATE UNTIL THAT BINDING IS SEPARATELY VERIFIED.
NO TERMINAL ACCEPTANCE FAMILY CAPABILITY OR OWNERSHIP CREDIT.
